title: What If a Nuke Hit Washington? Who Gets Out in 11 Minutes
description:
What would one nuclear bomb do to Washington, DC, and where does the government go?

A simulated 100 kiloton warhead gives the capital 11 minutes of warning: this video follows who moves, minute by minute, and what the rings cover.

Ten eleven, Washington: one nuclear warhead bursts above the White House. Eleven minutes earlier, a submarine in the North Atlantic fired one missile. Analysts estimate a president would have less than ten minutes to decide. So who is still in the chain of command at ten twelve?

This is a simulation. It has not happened. Scenario segments are labelled SIMULATION on screen; facts are labelled REAL DATA or REAL HISTORY. We name no attacker and set no date.

Chapters
0:00 Cold open
0:29 The day the government left
1:33 How close, how fast
3:25 The trigger
4:42 Minute by minute
6:53 One warhead, ring by ring
8:24 The day after

Key sources
- Congressional Research Service, Defense Primer: Command and Control of Nuclear Forces (IF10521): https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/IF10521.html
- Congressional Research Service, Defense Primer: Nuclear Command, Control and Communications (IF11697): https://www.everycrsreport.com/files/2025-08-15_IF11697_5ef7c11993f9d5a57cead70dc4c1b5d3afc026cc.html
- Frank von Hippel, Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists (2021): https://thebulletin.org/2021/06/biden-should-end-the-launch-on-warning-option/
- CRS, House Vacancies: Proposed Constitutional Amendments (RL32031): https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/RL32031.html
- Continuity of Government Commission, Brookings (2003): https://www.brookings.edu/articles/preserving-our-institutions-the-first-report-of-the-continuity-of-government-commission/
- Cornell Law, 3 U.S.C. 19, the line of succession: https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/3/19
- Federation of American Scientists, Secrecy News on the 2001 continuity activation: https://sgp.fas.org/news/secrecy/2002/03/030402.html
- History.com, the government's doomsday hideouts: https://www.history.com/articles/inside-the-governments-top-secret-doomsday-hideouts
Blast and burn figures: our scenario engine (Glasstone and Dolan, The Effects of Nuclear Weapons, 1977, calibrated to NUKEMAP by Alex Wellerstein).

How this video was made: the narration is AI-generated (Google Text-to-Speech). Scenario segments are simulations built from published models and open sources; the launch point, yield, target and the order of events are ours, a scenario, not a forecast.
Maps: Natural Earth (public domain), OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) via OpenFreeMap and OpenMapTiles. Imagery: NASA Blue Marble and Black Marble. Thumbnail backgrounds are AI-generated. Music: generated with Eleven Music.
